description:
Your church details show on the church website, on letterheads and in reports. Change the sample name 'My Church' to the name of your church. Add your logo, address and a short description.

Click your church in the list to open it. To see what each field means, open the menu with the three dots at the top of the page and click Take the Tour.

Only a Church Manager or a System Manager can change the church details.
name: Church
